people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and captured the royal fortress.
